name: Critter Peek
hook: Tap the bushes to find the hiding animals.
how: The picture card shows which animal to find; your child taps bushes, logs and haystacks until it hops out, and after two wrong tries the right spot wiggles to help. No reading needed, and finding them all starts a parade.
controls: Tap with one finger; the mouse works too
uses: Animal buddies peek slowly and leave the finding to your child.
You see each other's fingers, and every peek, at once.
One player's browser keeps the round; if it leaves, the next takes over.
ideas: Make them dinosaurs hiding in a jungle
